name: DominoPost – Advanced Post Editor with AI Writer, Link Building Suite, Free Google Search Console & GA4 Analytics
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
DominoPost is the industry-leading productivity suite for professional bloggers, SEO agencies, and content creators. It combines an advanced AI Writer, an automated Link Building & Orphan Post Rescue Suite, deep Google Search Console & Google Analytics 4 Intelligence, and modern Classic Editor / TinyMCE power tools directly into your WordPress dashboard.

Built by DominoPress, this toolkit eliminates the need for 5+ heavy plugins by unifying article generation, semantic internal linking, search console tracking, content decay detection, and visitor behavior analytics in one blazingly fast interface.

👉 Unlock the Full Power of DominoPost PRO Here

💎 DominoPost PRO: The Advanced AI Suite

Upgrade your content game with the DominoPost PRO Addon, featuring our most advanced automation engines:

  • ⚡ AI Smart Semantic Internal Interlinker: Automatically scans your site and inserts high-relevance internal links with natural context-aware anchor text.
  • 🌐 Smart AI External Link Placement: Paste any external or affiliate URL and let AI discover the perfect spot to insert it naturally.
  • ✨ AI Smart Rewrite (Magic Wand): Select any sentence or paragraph to instantly rewrite it with 4 professional tones (Friendly, Creative, Professional, Concise).
  • ❓ AI FAQ Schema Generator: Generate interactive FAQ blocks with automated JSON-LD Schema to capture Google’s “People Also Ask” rich snippets.
  • ✍️ 1-Click AI Grammar & Tone Polisher: Instantly clean up typos, passive voice, and phrasing across your entire post with a single click.
  • 🎯 Unlimited AI Generations & Bulk Article Expansion: Generate long-form articles in bulk without daily throttling.

🚀 DominoPost FREE: 100% Free Powerhouse Features

Get started with an unprecedented array of free blogging and SEO tools:

  • 🔗 Link Building & Orphan Posts Suite (FREE):
    • Keyword Rules Engine: Set keyword-to-URL rules to automatically inject internal links across your published content.
    • Orphan Posts Rescue: Detects posts with zero inbound internal links and automatically pairs them with low-outbound posts, building a healthy internal link architecture without link stuffing.
    • Inbound & Outbound Ratio Health: Visual counters and live health indicators for internal links sent and received across your entire blog.
  • 📈 SEO Analytics (Google Search Console – 100% FREE):
    • Real-Time Performance Dashboard: Track Total Clicks, Impressions, Average CTR, and Average Position without leaving WordPress.
    • Blogger Action Hub (Smart):
      • Content Decay Radar: Spots posts suffering from traffic or ranking drops with direct 1-click WordPress edit links.
      • Striking Distance Keywords: Surfaces high-impression keywords ranking in positions 8–20 that can hit Page 1 with minor on-page optimization.
      • CTR / Headline Fixer: Flags queries ranking on Page 1 with low CTR (< 2.5%) for instant title tag rewrites.
    • Smart Opportunity Filters: Filter queries by Top 10, Striking Distance, Zero-Click, High Impressions, and Low CTR.
    • Flexible Date Range & Comparison Engine: Filter by Today, Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, Last 90 Days, or Period-over-Period comparisons with automatic GSC API latency clamping.
  • 📊 Google Analytics 4 Dashboard (100% FREE):
    • Realtime Visitor Monitor: View active users right now, their locations, and what pages they are viewing.
    • Engagement Intelligence Engine:
      • Content Engagement Matrix: Quadrant classification sorting posts into Viral Hits, High Value Assets, Low Engagement Traffic, and Under-promoted Gems.
      • Top Converting Landing Pages: Ranks articles driving the highest conversion rates and reader engagement.
    • Traffic Acquisition Breakdown: Analyze organic search, referrals, direct traffic, and social channels.
    • Unified Date Range Filtering: Seamless period selection and comparison tracking matching SEO Analytics.
  • 🔍 SEO + Analytics Merged Intelligence (FREE):
    • Directly cross-references Google Search Console query rankings and impressions with Google Analytics user engagement time and conversions per URL.
  • ✍️ AI Content Writer (Standard):
    • Supports Google Gemini (Default), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras AI, OpenAI, and OpenRouter with ultra-fast streaming article generation.
  • ⚡ Pro Table of Contents (TOC): 4 stunning styles (Bullets, Numbers, Minimal, Boxed) with smooth-scrolling, live preview, and Google-friendly semantic markup.
  • 🤖 Content Assistant: 1-click tools for Blog Post Ideas, Article Outlines, Summaries, SEO Meta Titles & Descriptions, and FAQ generation.
  • 🔍 Google Keyword Research: Real-time related keyword suggestions inside the AI Writer modal.
  • 🕵️‍♂️ Site-Wide Broken Link Checker: Fast, automated link audits inside the Tools menu.
  • 🔍 Bulk Title Editor Suite: Batch find-and-replace, title suffix additions, and manual overrides.
  • 🔄 Find & Replace: Find and replace text directly inside the editor.
  • 🔗 Smart Related Posts & Content Update Reminders: Prevent content decay and keep readers engaged.
  • 😀 Emoji Picker & Table Builder: Add visual flair and structured tables from the toolbar.
  • 📊 Sidebar SEO Post Analysis: Live word counts, reading time, and keyword density.

🔗 Link Building Suite: Automated Internal Linking & Orphan Rescue

Internal linking is the highest-ROI SEO strategy for blogs. DominoPost provides a dedicated Link Building center:
* Keyword Linking Rules: Map your core focus keywords to target URLs. The engine scans your published posts and creates links safely without manual editing.
* Orphan Posts Rescue: Posts with zero inbound links miss out on page authority. The rescue engine pairs orphan posts with articles that currently send low outbound links, maintaining a natural, balanced link flow.
* Link Capping & Anti-Stuffing: Set maximum link limits per post to keep your reading experience natural and avoid search engine penalties.

📈 SEO Analytics Dashboard: Google Search Console Integration (FREE)

Stop leaving WordPress to check Search Console!
* Blogger Action Hub: Actionable recommendations that tell you which decaying posts to update today, which striking keywords to target, and which headlines to rewrite.
* Period Comparisons: Compare current performance against the previous period with automatic diff calculations and directional badges.
* Keyword Trend Intelligence: Quickly identify growing queries versus declining queries.

📊 Google Analytics 4 Dashboard: Engagement Intelligence (FREE)

  • Content Engagement Matrix: Visualizes which articles hold reader attention and which bounce quickly.
  • Top Converting Pages: Identify the posts that drive newsletter signups, sales, or lead generation.
  • Realtime Pulse: See who is browsing your blog at this exact moment.

Why Choose DominoPost?

  1. Lightweight & Fast: Modular architecture built with zero bloat. Keeps your admin and site loading instantly.
  2. SEO-First Design: Engineered to boost organic rankings, maximize internal link equity, and improve search CTR.
  3. The Ultimate Classic Editor Alternative: If you love the speed and simplicity of the Classic Editor, DominoPost transforms it with modern React intelligence.

Credits

Developed by DominoPress – Making WordPress Content Creation Smarter, Faster, and more Human.
Visit us: https://dominopress.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopost-advanced-post-editor folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. (Optional) Install the DominoPost PRO Addon to unlock the advanced AI automation suite.
  4. Visit DominoPost Settings to configure your API key and default styles.
  5. Start creating world-class content!
sections.faq:
Are Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 free?

Yes! Both SEO Analytics (Google Search Console) and Google Analytics 4 dashboards with the Blogger Action Hub and Engagement Matrix are 100% free with no tier locks.

How does the Orphan Posts Rescue work?

Orphan Posts Rescue identifies published posts with zero inbound internal links and connects them with posts that have sent zero or few outbound links, ensuring balanced distribution across your site without keyword stuffing.

Does it support Google Gemini, Groq, Cerebras, and OpenAI?

Yes! We support Google Gemini (2.5 Flash/Pro), Groq (Meta Llama), Cerebras AI, OpenRouter, and any OpenAI-compatible API key.

Is the Table of Contents SEO friendly?

Absolutely. Our TOC follows semantic HTML structures and uses clean IDs for perfect Google crawling.

Does the PRO Addon require the Free version?

Yes, the PRO Addon is an enhancement that plugs into the robust DominoPost core.
